reason: The closure stands, and the main code claim checks out. In exp70g filter_output_graph (notebook l.4550-4574), 'if motion_edges: edges = motion_edges' replaces every ILP edge with the 1:1 Hungarian relink. The exp70g public-run run_stats (4 datasets) show fallback_raw 0, skipped_large_frame 0 and deadline_degraded 0. Frames are about 340 nodes at most against the 2600 cap. REPAIR_DEADLINE 9.5 h is well above the 7.4 h runtimes. So an ILP fork cannot reach our output directly. SINGLE_CHILD_REPAIR and DIVISION_GEOMETRY_FILTER are 0, so forks would pass only on the exception or large-frame fallback, which is negligible. Two parts of the stated reason are too strong. (1) 'No output channel' is wrong as written. The relink cost is motion - 1.0*prob over the ILP edge keys (l.3270, LEARNED_BONUS 1.0). At weight 0.4 there are more ILP forks, which add parent -> second-daughter bonus keys of up to 1 um. That can flip which daughter the Hungarian takes, or pull a daughter away from a wrong neighbour. The ILP node set also moves (<1%). This second-order channel is real, and no one has measured it: exp60 edge_cache holds 0 ILP edges, so there is no replay bed. 'Orphan supply essentially unchanged' is therefore plausible but asserted, not measured. (2) 'JT's gain is base-specific' is a guess. JT's base is an x138 fork with the same relink. His +0.001 is rounding, his unpublished PP, or this same bonus channel, and we cannot tell which. None of this reopens the line. The knob is a public knob-ladder rung, it is past the R8 hard line (27 Sep 12:00), and it has no honest gate and no dummy. Only the ledger wording needs fixing.
